faq_a_ai_assistant: Every Space can activate an AI Assistant. It can summarize conversations, suggest ideas, and help moderate content. Tap the Space settings to manage your AI.
faq_a_app_guide: 1. Register & Verify. 2. Setup your Profile (including birthday). 3. Join or Create a Space. 4. Use collaborative tools like Whiteboard. 5. Schedule activities. 6. Secure your Privacy Vault. 7. Explore Marketplace (Buy & Sell).
faq_a_dark_mode: Go to Settings > Account Identity and look for theme preferences. You can choose between Light, Dark, or System default. Changes apply immediately.
faq_a_linked_devices: Yes! In Settings > Linked Devices, you can see all active sessions and revoke access remotely for security.
faq_a_market_conditions: Items can be listed as New, Like New, Refurbished, or Used. This helps you understand the item's state before purchasing.
faq_a_market_delivery: Sellers can specify if they offer delivery. Look for the delivery icon (box) on the item card to see availability.
faq_a_market_how_to: To buy, browse the 'Browse' tab, select an item, and tap 'Message' to chat with the seller. To sell, tap the '+' button in the Marketplace tab to create your listing.
faq_a_my_items: Switch to the 'My Items' tab in the Marketplace to see all your active, sold, and inactive listings. You can edit or delete them from there.
faq_a_privacy_vault: The Privacy Vault allows you to secure specific chats, media, and profile details behind an extra layer of protection. Access it via Settings > Privacy.
faq_a_report_content: Tap the three-dot menu on any post or message and select 'Report'. Our AI moderation system reviews reports within 24 hours.
faq_a_schedule_activity: Tap the calendar icon in your Space to propose or schedule an activity. You can set a title, duration, and make it recurring. Look for the activity badge in the header for upcoming events!
faq_a_spaces_types: Zmzir offers three main space types: Channels (public broadcasts), Protected (private groups requiring membership), and Direct (1-on-1 private collaboration).
faq_a_storage_management: Go to Settings > Storage & Data. You can clear your local cache, set media auto-clear intervals, and choose between HD or Original upload quality.
faq_a_synchronicity: Synchronicity is Zmzir's collaborative matching system. It suggests ideal collaborators and enhances teamwork by analyzing interaction patterns.
faq_a_trust_score: Your Trust Score reflects your positive contributions and reporting integrity. High scores unlock protected features and enhance your reputation in the community.
